title: T-CABS Implementation Guide
introduction: FHIR R4 profiles for telemedical monitoring of home-based ventilation therapy and vital parameters.

list.desc: Patch: iVAPS remapped to 475154, breath proportion and usage duration on T-CABS CodeSystem codes, median and maximum mappings set to wider, non-invasive blood pressure targets for Doccla

DeviceAlert profile hierarchy with event and limit base profiles, full R6 element set, obstructive apnea and leakage alarms, conditional mode mappings via dependsOn, mode code corrections, metadata and FAIR page
ValueSet split (Limit Exceedance), code patterns in event-based alerts, R6 alignment fixes (unknown status, mapping table), DeviceAlerts in transaction bundles, German pagecontent additions
DeviceAlert R6 backport (8 profiles), alarm code refactoring, multi-language support (en+de), UML diagram split, IEEE code corrections, PHD 2.0.0 upgrade
